reasons: Conflicting constraints: CS4218 requires CS3213 or CS3219 (CS3219 is completed, so CS4218 is eligible). However, the student states 'I definitely can't have CS2102 and CS2101 together' and 'I definitely can't have CS4223 and CS2102 together'. The student must take CS2102, CS2101, CS4218, CS4278, CS4223, CS4268. CS4223 requires CS3210 or CS3220 or CG3207. CS3210 requires CS2100 (completed) or others. CS4268 requires CS3230 (completed) and EE2012A/EE2012 etc. The student has not completed EE2012 or EE2012A. CS4268 prerequisite includes (EE2012A or EE2012 or ...). These are not in the completed list. Thus CS4268 is not eligible. Also CS4278 requires CS3263 or CS3243. Neither is completed. CS3263 requires CS2109S (completed) and CS2040S (completed) and MA2001 (not completed, and MA2001 is NOT open to BComp CS Hons). CS3243 requires CS2040S (completed) and CS1231S (completed). So CS3243 is eligible. CS4278 requires CS3243 (if planned) and MA2001 (not open) or MA1522 (completed) or ... wait, CS4278 prereq: (CS3263 or CS3243) AND (MA2001 or ...) AND (EE2012 or ...) AND (MA2002 or ...). MA2002 is NOT open to BComp CS Hons. EE2012 is not completed. So CS4278 is not eligible. Since CS4278 is a 'must' course and cannot be taken, no plan exists.
